pr_title: Fix reload freeze when not modsetting current mode
pr_body:
Fixes #3685 with swaywm/wlroots#1545 -- which was
reverted in swaywm/wlroots#1550 due to #3685

On master, all output configs are applied on reload. This may cause an
output to have its config applied up to three times, instead of just
once. The three cases are: output name, output identifier, and wildcard.
Not only is this inefficient, but it can cause swaybg to be spawned and
immediately killed.

However, swaybg requires two roundtrips of wl_display (to obtain needed
globals) before it enters its normal event loop. Modesetting will
roundtrip the wl_display. Without modesetting, waitpid for killing
swaybg could block infinitely due to swaybg being blocked by
wl_display_roundtrip.

This only configured an output once. It either uses the wildcard config
or creates an empty wildcard config and applies that. This also fixes a
bug where an output would not be reset when there is no output config to
apply to it.

issue_context.title: Display freeze on config reload.
issue_context.body:
Reloading the config ($mod+Shift+C) under ordinary conditions is freezing my display. I think the system is still responsive because I can still hear audio play after triggering it.

Can anyone else reproduce this?
comments:
I am not able to replicate. Would you be able to provide a debug log? The following should allow you to obtain one without having to do a hard reboot:
```
(sleep 10 && killall sway) &
sway -d 2> sway.log
```

If this just started happening today, can you try rolling wlroots back to https://github.com/swaywm/wlroots/commit/5c8d2da0a1cd3839663d070532ba45bd61d374ca? Maybe there is a case where modesetting to the current mode is needed that is being overlooked.

This only happens to me if I have a background set in my config.

Log of me reloading my config (but with `sway -V`, not -d) https://gist.github.com/ggreer/df9cfbf1bec06d9b73524aef246d1963

If I try to kill swaybg with `kill -TERM`, it becomes a zombie process.

```
ggreer@iron:~/code/sway% ps ax | ag swaybg
 1936 tty1     Z+     0:00 [swaybg] <defunct>
 3390 pts/0    S+     0:00 ag swaybg
```

```
2019-02-15 01:05:40 - [sway/config/output.c:176] Unable to terminate swaybg [pid: 1713]
```

Interesting. Maybe we block in `waitpid`.

We should probably just disconnect the client instead of killing it.
Actually I am able to replicate this. Reverting https://github.com/swaywm/wlroots/pull/1545 fixes it for me.
https://github.com/swaywm/wlroots/pull/1545 has been reverted so I'm closing this. I believe @RedSoxFan is going to look into getting it working as it would've otherwise been nice to have.

FWIW with this commit I was also experiencing freezes on shutdown, because swaybar wasn't killed properly:

```
2019-02-16 11:48:41 - [sway/config/bar.c:22] Terminating swaybar 8978
<freeze>
```

review_comments:
The wildcard config is only ever applied directly when there is no output specific config. If there is an output specific config, that is applied instead.

https://github.com/swaywm/sway/blob/77a3694a782f48ea476958bf97e3f82ebafae0b1/sway/config/output.c#L375-L381
